guards.effect: Server.restart() is @Unsupported; CraftServer.restart throws (CraftServer#5) and Spigot's RestartCommand.restart throws (RestartCommand#1). The /restart command itself enqueues into MinecraftServer.processQueue (RestartCommand:23), which is never drained, so /restart silently does nothing.
guards.note: REPLACE (admin-facing; restart scripts are common). Status 2026-10-21: the refusal now carries an owned message (Paper 0019, see RestartCommand#1/CraftServer#5); Spigot /restart still enqueues into the undrained queue, which since MC 0060 fails loudly instead of silently (UndrainedQueue). Sketch: a SourbyCraft restart that (1) kicks players with spigot.yml restart-message, (2) halts through the engine's shutdown path (MinecraftServer.stopServer -> haltServerRegionThreading, which the auto-updater's apply path already relies on; see update/ and docs/development/AUTO-UPDATER.md), and (3) execs spigot.yml restart-script from a JVM shutdown hook, as Spigot's addShutdownHook does. Owned command replies instead of UnsupportedOperationException. Risk: the restart script running while the region shutdown thread is still saving; the hook must run after RegionShutdownThread completes (it joins on the shutdown thread today). Test: unit test of the hook ordering with an injected process launcher; test-server run with a no-op script.
